nodes.title: C1 item 9 (M4): Stagecraft's reveal point uses the skill being taught (state.lastMove.skillId, not kit.skills[0]); its sources are fed at the point (kernel-point feedPoint: a state input that invalidates on a topic, skill or beat change, the beat lookahead from server/stagecraft/lookahead.js on a change, the stuck signal from two non-correct graded answers; STAGECRAFT_FEEDS=off disables them); seam slotFor never reveals or keeps a Stagecraft piece whose skill differs from the move's skill (hint.skillId from Brain patch 009). Feeding at the point instead of after her reply needs no Brain hook (replay: 0.597 vs 0.590 built ahead).
nodes.reversal: Brain's planBeat lookahead ships (replace lookahead.js NEXT_BEATS with it), or live traces show the guard dropping more than ~15% of reveals (then build the point after the move instead)
